attributes.board_name: Kansas State Board of Healing Arts

rules.accepted_credit_types: Category I: Board-approved educational presentations; Category II: Board-approved activities incl. self-study; Category III: pain management, opioid prescribing or PDMP use (1 credit hour = 50 minutes)
rules.alternatives: Instead of 50 hours in the preceding year: 100 hours in the preceding two years (40 Category I, 2 Category III), or evidence of equivalent hours from a national, state or local organization with standards at least as stringent.
rules.new_licensee_rule: PAs initially licensed within one year of a renewal date are exempt for that first renewal.

topics.who: All PAs: Category III hour on acute/chronic pain management, opioid prescribing or prescription drug monitoring programs (2 hours under the 100-hour option)

rules.notes: Licenses are cancelled on Dec 31 each year (issued Oct 1-Dec 31: Dec 31 of the next year). Evidence of CE is submitted with the renewal application. Up to 6-month extension on request with a plan. KSBHA site blocked (403); facts from K.A.R.
